summary: WhiteFiber, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that its subsidiary entered into a $100 million delayed-draw term loan facility (expandable to $150 million) with Bit Digital Capital. The loan carries 9.5% interest (8% after a rate-step event) and a 3% OID, with a nine-month availability period. Proceeds will fund completion of an HPC data center in North Carolina and other growth initiatives. This is a routine debt financing arrangement, not a special-situation event like an acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or activist campaign. The filing describes a standard credit facility with no change of control or extraordinary corporate action.
